title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct Geisel Library study environments, from reservable whiteboard rooms to silent carrels and collaborative lower-level seating.

cards.title: Geisel Library Study Room 1
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · group room for up to six
cards.notes: Reserve through the Circulation Desk, bring your student ID for key checkout, and use the whiteboard to map a small-group work session.
cards.short_summary: A six-person upper-level room with a whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 1 is on Geisel Library’s upper level, holds up to six people, and has a whiteboard; student reservations are limited to two hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Saint Anselm students only; reserve by calling 603-641-7300 or visiting Circulation. Present student ID to check out the key; two hours per day.

cards.title: Geisel Library Study Room 2
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · group room for up to six
cards.notes: Coordinate a group beforehand, reserve at Circulation, and use the whiteboard for shared outlines, problem sets, or review prompts.
cards.short_summary: A second six-person upper-level room with a whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 2 is an upper-level Geisel Library group study room for up to six people and includes a whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Saint Anselm students only; reserve by calling 603-641-7300 or visiting Circulation. Present student ID to check out the key; two hours per day.

cards.title: Geisel Library Study Room 3
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · group room for up to eight
cards.notes: Reserve this room when a shared screen would help; the monitor and whiteboard support comparing drafts, slides, or research materials together.
cards.short_summary: An eight-person group room with a monitor and whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 3 is on Geisel Library’s upper level, holds up to eight people, and includes a flat-screen monitor and whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Saint Anselm students only; reserve by calling 603-641-7300 or visiting Circulation. Present student ID to check out the key; two hours per day.

cards.title: Geisel Library Study Room 4
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · group room for up to eight
cards.notes: Book this upper-level room for a group session that needs a display; check out markers at Circulation or Periodicals for the whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: An eight-person room equipped for shared-screen group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 4 is an upper-level Geisel Library group study room for up to eight people with a flat-screen monitor and whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Saint Anselm students only; reserve by calling 603-641-7300 or visiting Circulation. Present student ID to check out the key; two hours per day.

cards.title: Geisel Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Main Level · tables, armchairs, and windows
cards.notes: Choose a table for spread-out materials or an armchair for reading; quiet talking is allowed on the main level, so plan accordingly.
cards.short_summary: Main-level seating with tables, armchairs, and window light.
cards.evidence_claim: The main-level Reading Room has large group study tables, soft armchairs, windows, and the Leisure Reading collection; quiet talking is allowed on the main level.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s main level. Follow library sound-level and food policies.

cards.title: Geisel Library Reference Area
cards.subtitle: Main Level · lamps and swivel-table armchairs
cards.notes: Set up at a lamped table for sustained work, or use a swivel-table armchair when you need a compact spot for a laptop and notes.
cards.short_summary: A main-level reference area with lamped tables and flexible armchairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Geisel Library’s main-level Reference area has large tables with lamps and soft armchairs with attached swivel tables.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s main level, where quiet talking is allowed. The Reference Desk is also on this level.

cards.entity_name: Geisel Library Main-Level Book Stacks Seating
cards.title: Geisel Library Main-Level Book Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Main Level · carrels and a window-side table
cards.notes: Use the individual carrels for focused reading, or claim the table by the window when you need room to keep books and a laptop open.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels and a table set between the main-level stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Geisel Library’s main-level book-stack seating includes individual study carrels and a large table by a window between the stacks.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s main level, where quiet talking is allowed. Follow library sound-level and food policies.

cards.title: Geisel Library Upper-Level Mixed Seating
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · soft chairs, carrels, and a window table
cards.notes: Head upstairs for silent study; choose the soft seating, a carrel, or the large window table based on how much material you need nearby.
cards.short_summary: A silent upper-level mix of soft chairs, carrels, and window seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Geisel Library’s upper-level mixed seating includes soft chairs, individual study carrels, and a large table by a window; the upper level is designated for silent study.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s silent-study upper level. The group study rooms are not sound-proof, so keep noise low throughout the floor.

cards.entity_name: Geisel Library Upper-Level Individual Study Carrels
cards.title: Geisel Library Upper-Level Individual Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Upper Level · silent individual seating
cards.notes: Bring a focused solo task to these upper-level carrels, where the library designates the floor for silent study and mostly individual seating.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated upper-level individual seating in a silent-study area.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper level of Geisel Library is a silent-study floor with mostly individual study carrels, plus some window seating and dimmer lighting.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s upper level; maintain silent-study expectations. Follow library food and beverage policies.

cards.entity_name: Geisel Library Lower-Level Group Study Area
cards.title: Geisel Library Lower-Level Group Study Area
cards.subtitle: Lower Level · alternative collaborative seating
cards.notes: Use this floor for a conversation-based assignment when reservable rooms are occupied, and keep discussion at the library’s normal-volume expectation.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level alternative for group work when rooms are occupied.
cards.evidence_claim: Geisel Library identifies the lower level as an alternative group study space when group rooms are in use, with normal-volume conversations allowed.
cards.access_notes: Located on Geisel Library’s lower level. Normal-volume conversations are allowed; louder conversations may be asked to lower their volume.
